data.title: The X Window System didn't immediately have X terminals
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 文章指出，由于大量使用旧浏览器用户代理的高流量爬虫（包括用于LLM训练的数据采集），作者在其博客和wiki（CSpace）中实施了反爬虫措施。如果用户使用被视为可疑的旧浏览器（尤其是Chrome），访问可能会被阻止。若用户确实在使用最新浏览器却遭遇问题，可联系作者提供浏览器信息（如User-Agent字符串）。此外，文章特别提到archive.*（如archive.today、archive.ph）的爬虫行为类似恶意爬虫，建议使用更规范的archive.org进行存档访问。作者为由此造成的不便表示歉意。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：X终端的发展、使用及其优缺点

不同观点：
• ch_123认为X最初是在DEC VAXstation 100图形终端上运行，该设备需要在主机系统中安装适配器卡，并能直接访问主机上的共享内存。而X终端的移植是在之后的工作站中实现的。
• somat指出，X终端的经济性不明显，因为即使不需要存储，仍需购买高性能的图形系统和CPU，这使得节省成本变得困难。
• ggm分享了早期X终端的管理和使用经验，强调其在多厂商硬件和操作系统间的互操作性，以及对网络性能的要求，并提到随着多媒体的普及，X终端的实用性下降。
• loph也强调了X终端的互操作性优势，指出它们相对便宜且不需要太多管理，但需要高速网络支持。
• dfox描述了NCD X终端的功能，如运行mwm、motif session manager等软件，并提到它们可以从flash PC卡或NFS启动。
• phibz提到目前仍使用No Machine NX session进行远程工作，以实现访问控制，防止数据泄露。
• pjmlp回忆了大学中使用IBM X终端连接DG/UX的经历，指出当时X终端并不便宜。

补充讨论：
• beej71和cbm-vic-20分享了他们在学院和校园中使用X终端的经历，强调其在访问特定应用程序方面的便利性。
• aa-jv讨论了使用Quarterdeck Desqview作为终端的经历，以及后来转向Linux的历程，并对Desqview/X的替代方案表示好奇。
• TMWNN推测X终端并未与X Window同时出现，因为Project Athena初期使用的是IBM RT PC等“真实”工作站。
• bitwize提到HP早期X终端使用186 CPU的情况，指出X系统在当时有限硬件上的支持能力。
• anthk引用了Linux Gazzete上的文章，回顾了当时的美好时光。

争议焦点：
• X终端是否真的经济实用，特别是在早期硬件成本较高的情况下。
• 随着多媒体的普及，X终端的实用性下降，其在现代环境中的适用性受到质疑。

44352311.article_content:
You're using a suspiciously old browser
You're probably reading this page because you've attempted to access
some part of
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
or
CSpace
, the wiki thing it's part of. Unfortunately
you're using a browser version that my anti-crawler precautions consider
suspicious, most often because it's too old (most often this applies to
versions of Chrome). Unfortunately, as of early 2025 there's a plague
of high volume crawlers (apparently in part to gather data for LLM
training) that use a variety of old browser user agents, especially
Chrome user agents. To reduce the load on
Wandering Thoughts
I'm experimenting with
(attempting to) block all of them, and you've run into this.
If this is in error and you're using a current version of your
browser of choice, you can contact me at
my current place at the
university
(you should be able to work out the email address
from that). If possible, please let me know what browser you're
using and so on, ideally with its exactl User-Agent string.
A special note for people using archive.*
You may be seeing this through archive.today, archive.ph, archive.is,
and so on. Unfortunately, archive.* crawls pages to archive in a way that
is impossible to distinguish from malicious actors. They use old Chrome
User-Agent values, crawl from IP address blocks that are widely distributed
and not clearly identified as theirs, and some of their IP addresses have
falsified reverse DNS entries that claim they are googlebot IP addresses
(which is something that is normally done only by quite bad actors). I
suggest that you use archive.org, which is a better behaved archival
crawler and can crawl
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
.
Chris Siebenmann, 2025-02-17

data.title: Encounters with Reality on Christine Rosen's the Extinction of Experience
data.author: prismatic
data.article_summary: 在《Encounters with Reality: On Christine Rosen’s "The Extinction of Experience"》一文中，Regina Munch 探讨了Christine Rosen对现代社会中经验消逝现象的批评。Rosen认为，技术进步和城市化导致人们与自然和真实社会互动的减少，从而引发“经验的灭绝”。这种现象不仅削弱了个人的实践智慧，还破坏了社会的共同经验基础。Munch进一步分析，这种经验丧失可能导致情感和智力的贫乏，使人们难以应对复杂的社会问题。文章呼吁人们反思技术依赖，重新建立与真实世界的联系，以保护和丰富人类的共同经验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对“体验”在现代社会中被虚假化和受数字技术影响的现象的看法，以及对相关哲学家和理论的引用。

不同观点：
• cess11认为，“体验”在现代社会中往往是虚假的，受数字技术操控，与伪现实接触。他将此现象归因于资本主义的驱动，并指出多位哲学家如Kierkegaard、Nietzsche、Marx、Freud、Debord、Baudrillard、Postman和Derrida等人都曾探讨过这一问题，早在千禧年之前的计算机爆炸时代就已有相关思考。

• readthenotes1则对这种抽象的哲学讨论表示怀疑，通过讽刺的语气质疑作者在两岁时是否真能获得深刻的见解，暗示对某些理论探讨的实际意义和应用价值的怀疑。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于“体验”虚假化及其与数字技术关系的理论探讨是否具有实际意义和价值。cess11支持这种理论分析，并引经据典加以论证；而readthenotes1则通过个人经历和质疑作者年幼时的理解能力，对理论的实际应用和意义提出挑战。

• 另一个值得注意的点是哲学理论在现代社会现象分析中的适用性和解释力，部分评论者可能认为这些理论过于抽象或缺乏实证支持。

data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: 本文简要介绍了Tandy公司的起源和发展。1919年，David Lewis Tandy和Norton Hinckley在福特沃斯创立了Hinckley-Tandy皮革公司，专门生产皮革鞋带、鞋底等产品。Tandy负责销售和市场，Hinckley管理内部运营。公司顺利发展，但在经济大萧条期间缩减了规模。Charles David Tandy是公司创始人的儿子，1948年退伍后创立了Tandy Leather业余爱好部门，成功实现100%的投资回报率。随着Tandy家族内部对公司未来方向的分歧，Tandy家族最终掌控了公司，并通过合并一家上市公司解决了财务问题。1955年，公司更名为General American Industries Inc，Tandy担任总裁。1959年，Tandy重新获得控制权，将公司更名为Tandy Corporation，并继续扩展业务，包括电子产品。到1961年，公司股票从4美元涨至11美元。

In 1919, a small leather company was founded in Fort Worth by David Lewis Tandy and Norton Hinckley. The Hinckley-Tandy Leather Company specialized in leather show laces, shoe soles, leather and rubber heels, and other shoe-findings. Tandy focused on sales and marketing while Hinckley managed the internal business operations and inventory. The company did well, bought a larger location in 1923 and expanded to Beaumont in 1927. The company scaled back during the Depression, but they survived.
Charles David Tandy
Charles David Tandy, the son of David Lewis Tandy, was born a year before Hinckley-Tandy started operations, and he began working at the company at the age of twelve. He graduated from Texas Christian University in 1940, briefly attended the Harvard Business School, and he then joined the US Navy. The younger Tandy served as a supply officer, but he also setup a leather working program for hospitalized personnel. This was successful, and it provided the inspiration for his first major contribution to Hinckley-Tandy after his discharge in 1948: Tandy Leather, a mail order hobby division of the company.
Disagreements between Hinckley and the Tandys were growing. Hinckley wanted to focus on the shoe-findings that had built the company, while the Tandys had greater ambitions. The Tandy family ended up in control of the company and the hobby division had achieved 100% ROI in its first year. In May of 1950, Charles Tandy opened the first two retail locations specialized in leather craft, but the company’s main revenues came from their mail order business. At two years, the company had achieved $2.9 million in sales, opened 15 stores, and wasn’t yet ready to stop its expansion. By 1952, the company had stores across the country, had acquired a few failing competitors, and had established an interesting method of encouraging both employees and store managers to succeed. Each store was incorporated individually, and store managers were required to own a 25% stake in the store. Should a manager lack the capital personally, Tandy Leather was available to provide the loan for that purpose, and Dave Tandy would serve as a co-signer should it be needed. For regular employees across the company, year end bonuses were provided, and all staff were eligible and encouraged to purchase equity. This worked well; by 1954, the company’s catalog was 68 pages and served a million customers, four factories stocked the shelves of 67 stores spread across 36 states and the territory of Hawaii.
While one might assume that taxation would require respiration, this is not so. In 1954, Dave Tandy passed away and the estate taxes hurt the company’s finances rather badly. This sudden shift in the company’s fortunes also meant that employee stock holders had no meaningful way to assess the value of their shares. As the remaining Tandy in our story saw it, the easiest way to ameliorate the concerns of share holders was for the company to go public. Given the company’s size, this would have been difficult, and he therefore sought a merger with an already publicly listed company.
The merger target Tandy found was the American Hide and Leather Company. AHLC was insolvent and this presented Tandy with the chance to remain in control of the resulting conglomerate. Tandy Leather provided AHLC the money to buy Tandy Leather, and Tandy Leather share holders had the option to buy shares in AHLC. This merger was completed in 1955, the company was renamed to General American Industries Inc, Tandy became the president, and the combined entity had a five year tax shelter due to AHLC’s insolvency. With AHLC as the corporate parent, profits from Tandy Leather were being used to cover the losses of other conglomerate members such as Western Leather and Tex Tan. To stop this would mean that Tandy would need to regain control. This was achieved in November of 1959.
With Tandy now in control, the unprofitable child companies were sold at a loss, the company’s headquarters was moved to Fort Worth, the conglomerate was renamed the Tandy Corporation, and the stock symbol became TAN. At open the stock was $4/share, and by the end of 1961 it was $11/share.
With ownership, earnings, taxes, and other issues settled, Tandy changed his focus back to growth. The first two initiatives were experimental retail stores Tandy Craft and Hobby Mart in November of 1961. The first stores were around 18,000 square feet, sold more than 50,000 items of varying kinds for a variety of hobbies, and notably included Electronic Crafts like DIY radio and stereo kits. Other diversification efforts continued over the decade with names like The Mart, and Pier 1 Imports.

data.title: The Sad Case of the Youngest-Ever Alzheimer's Diagnosis
data.author: breitling
data.article_summary: 2023年，中国一家记忆诊所的神经科医生诊断了一名19岁少年患有阿尔茨海默病，成为全球最年轻的阿尔茨海默病患者。患者从17岁起出现记忆力下降，脑部扫描显示海马体萎缩，脑脊液中存在阿尔茨海默病的生物标志物。尽管通常此病见于老年人，但早发性病例占总病例的10%。该少年的病例特殊，未发现与家族遗传相关的基因突变，且无其他疾病或外伤史。他的认知衰退严重到无法完成高中学业，但仍能独立生活。医生认为此病例改变了对阿尔茨海默病典型发病年龄的理解，表明其病因复杂，需进一步研究。该研究发表于《阿尔茨海默病期刊》。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：使用尸源组织治疗的安全性及其潜在风险

不同观点：
• 观点一：有评论者提到了一种担忧，即多年前接受过尸源组织治疗的患者中，有部分人在没有相关病史的情况下出现了类似阿尔茨海默病的症状。这让人联想到治疗过程中可能存在的交叉感染风险。[rincebrain]
• 观点二：评论中引用的研究指出，这种治疗方法后来因为担心传播如CJD（克雅氏病）等朊病毒疾病而被禁止，表明早期的治疗可能存在严重的安全隐患。[rincebrain]

补充讨论：

44352446.article_content:
The Sad Case of The World's Youngest-Ever Alzheimer's Diagnosis
Health
22 June 2025
By
Carly Cassella
(koto_feja/Getty Images)
In 2023, neurologists at a memory clinic in China diagnosed a 19-year-old with what they believed to be
Alzheimer's
disease – making him the youngest person ever to be diagnosed with the condition.
The teen first began experiencing memory decline around age 17, with symptoms worsening over time.
Brain scans revealed shrinkage in the hippocampus, a region involved in memory, while his cerebrospinal fluid showed biomarkers consistent with Alzheimer's – the most common form of dementia.
Although usually associated with older age, early-onset cases of Alzheimer's (those occurring in individuals under age 65) represent up to 10 percent of all diagnoses.
Alzheimer's is today an incredibly common disease among older people, but it's comparatively rare in the young. (zeljkosantrac/Getty Images)
Almost all Alzheimer's patients under the age of 30 can have their disease explained by pathological gene mutations, classifying them as having familial Alzheimer's disease (
FAD
). The younger a person is when they receive a diagnosis, the more likely it is caused by an inherited faulty gene.
However, researchers at Beijing's Capital Medical University were unable to find any of the usual mutations responsible for the early onset of memory loss, nor any suspect genes, after conducting a genome-wide search.
Before this diagnosis in China,
the youngest patient with Alzheimer's
was 21 years old. They carried the
PSEN1 gene mutation
, which causes abnormal proteins to build up in the brain, forming clumps of toxic plaques, a common feature of Alzheimer's.
Cases like this one pose something of a mystery. None of the 19-year-old's family had a history of Alzheimer's or dementia, making it hard to categorize it as FAD, yet the teenager had no other diseases, infections, or head trauma that could explain his sudden cognitive decline either.
Two years before being referred to the memory clinic, the teenage patient began struggling to focus in class. Reading also became difficult and his short-term memory declined. Oftentimes, he couldn't remember events from the day before, and he was always misplacing his belongings.
Patients over 65 account for the vast majority of AD cases. (Maskot/Getty Images)
Ultimately, the cognitive decline became so bad, the young man was unable to finish high school, although he could still live independently.
A year after being referred to the memory clinic, he showed losses in immediate recall, short-delay recall after three minutes, and long-delay recall after 30 minutes.
The patient's full-scale memory score was 82 percent lower than that of peers his own age, while his immediate memory score was 87 percent lower.
Long-term follow-up is needed to support the young man's diagnosis, but his medical team
said
at the time the patient was "altering our understanding of the typical age of onset of AD."
"The patient had very early-onset AD with no clear pathogenic mutations," neurologist Jianping Jia and colleagues
wrote in their study
, "which suggests that its pathogenesis still needs to be explored."
The case study, published in February 2023, just goes to show that Alzheimer's doesn't follow a single pathway, and is
much more complex
than we thought, emerging
via numerous avenues
with varying effects.
In a
statement
to the South China Morning Post, the neurologists who described the patient's case argued that future studies should focus on early-onset cases to further improve our understanding of memory loss.
"Exploring the mysteries of young people with Alzheimer's disease may become one of the most challenging scientific questions of the future," they
said
.
The study was published in the
Journal of Alzheimer's Disease
.
An earlier version of this article was published in February 2023.

data.author: sandebert
data.article_summary: 纪录片制作人劳伦·格林菲尔德通过拍摄25名青少年的线上和线下生活，揭示了一个充满性暗示图片、强奸文化、霸凌和自杀倾向的世界。她的五集系列《Social Studies》展示了这一代社交媒体原住民的生活，捕捉到青少年偷偷外出、发布露骨图片、经历网络霸凌和自杀念头等现象。该系列有望获得艾美奖。格林菲尔德最初在洛杉矶的高中进行了200多次小型采访，最终选定了25名青少年，他们同意分享屏幕录制，使她能够实时了解他们的在线生活。这一项目不仅让她作为家长的观念发生了变化，也使她更加关注青少年面临的不安全环境，呼吁社会采取行动。格林菲尔德表示，拍摄这个系列让她意识到需要提高 awareness，并推动集体行动。

不同观点：

  - 论据：现代社会中手机和社交媒体对孩子的注意力和心理健康有负面影响，类似于香烟对健康的危害。

• 观点二：完全禁止或延迟使用手机和社交媒体可能导致孩子与同龄人脱节。  
  - 论据：在现代社会中，手机和社交媒体是重要的社交工具，完全避免使用可能导致孩子在社交方面遇到困难。  
  - 例子：孩子可能会因为无法参与同龄人之间的在线交流而感到孤立，影响社交能力的发展。

• 争议焦点：严格限制孩子使用手机和社交媒体是否会对孩子的社交能力造成负面影响，还是能够真正保护他们的注意力和心理健康。

Interview
‘Have you heard of this BDSM trend?’ What I learned recording thousands of hours of teens on their phones
Paula Cocozza
When documentary-maker Lauren Greenfield immersed herself in the online and offline lives of 25 teenagers, she unearthed a world of sexually explicit images, rape culture, bullying and suicidal ideation. Adolescence, she says, has become like the wild west
Sun 22 Jun 2025 09.00 EDT
Share
R
eactions to Lauren Greenfield’s documentary series
Social Studies
tend to fall into two categories. Young people think it is validating; adults think it’s a horror show. After all, the screen of a teenager’s smartphone is a shiny black hole to which access is rarely granted. “Our kids are right there,” as Greenfield puts it, “and yet we don’t really know what’s going on in their lives.”
Her five-part series, which tracks the online and offline lives of a group of teenagers and young adults – the first generation of social media natives – is being
tipped for an Emmy
. Under the noses of their parents, she captures teenagers climbing out of bedroom windows to spend the night with boyfriends, posting sexually explicit images, tracking their longest-ever fast (91 hours) and living out their experiences of rape, cyberbullying, whitewashing, the tyranny of Caucasian beauty standards and suicidal ideation. She makes adolescence look like the wild west.
I was blaming my son for his screen time, and ended up feeling that’s like blaming an opium addict for their addiction
“I really tried to go into this as a social experiment,” says Greenfield, speaking on a video call from the Fahey/Klein Gallery in Los Angeles, which is hosting a Social Studies
photographic exhibition
until July. Initially she conducted more than 200 mini-interviews in high schools in LA, and then whittled these down to a cohort of about 25, who let her shoot them at home, at school, at parties, and in discussion groups over the course of the 2021-22 high school year. Crucially, they agreed to screen record, thereby sharing their online lives with Greenfield in real time. The result is a frenetic, immersive collage of a documentary, in which screens are overlaid on in-person lives. It is sometimes hard to keep pace, and hard to know where to look – but that is the point.
Greenfield started out in anthropology; her first commission was for National Geographic, photographing Maya people in Mexico. Her mother, Patricia Marks Greenfield, a psychologist, was the writer. But after the project was dropped, she turned her gaze closer to home, to LA, where she grew up. Since her first monograph,
Fast Forward: Growing Up in the Shadow of Hollywood
, her work has focused on consumerism, extreme wealth, addiction and youth culture.
The idea for Social Studies partly came from observing her youngest son Gabriel’s phone habits. He was 14 when she started filming the series. “We had constant battles about screen time.” Arguments? “Yes,” she says. “I never could control his access or see the content on his phone. He was super private about his phone, which is probably why I was so obsessed with getting into phones and really seeing what was in there.”
View image in fullscreen
Going viral … Bella and Holly in Social Studies.
Photograph: Lauren Greenfield/Institute/FX
Alongside about 1,000 hours of documentary footage, Greenfield also captured 2,000 hours of screen-recorded content. Her son “helped to figure out the tech”. He was a year younger than most of the young people featured – and filming was personally confronting for Greenfield as a parent. Not least when she ran into him at a party she was filming.
Making Social Studies has triggered her own evolution as a parent. “I was blaming my son for his screen time,” she says. “And I ended up feeling that’s like blaming an opium addict for their addiction.
Social media
is made to be addictive – purposefully, for maximum engagement, and without any concern for the consequences.” Social Studies “brought me together with my teenager”, she says.
Greenfield has previously said that she went into her 2002 monograph
Girl Culture
with an open mind “and came out a feminist”. (She later directed the
#LikeAGirl
Super Bowl commercial.) Was the experience of filming Social Studies transformative too? Did she come out an activist?
“I definitely came out thinking that we were giving a very unsafe environment to our young people and we needed to do something about it,” she says. “I did come out of it wanting to spread the word, raise awareness. It’s about collective action.”

data.title: That Revolutionary May Day in 1976 When California Wines Bested France's Finest
data.author: mindracer
data.article_summary: 1976年的“巴黎评判”是一次历史性的盲品会，改变了葡萄酒界的格局。英国葡萄酒商Steven Spurrier组织了这场品鉴会，邀请法国专家对加州和法国的葡萄酒进行盲品。结果出乎意料，1973年份的Chateau Montelena霞多丽和1973年份的Stag's Leap Wine Cellars赤霞珠击败了法国顶级酒，引起轰动。这一事件使加州葡萄酒声名鹊起，成为世界顶级葡萄酒产区之一。品鉴会的成功也让两位加州酿酒师Miljenko (Mike) Grgich和Warren Winiarski崭露头角。这两瓶获胜葡萄酒如今被收藏于史密森学会美国历史国家博物馆。

Bottles of the two triumphant vintages 1973 Chateau Montelena chardonnay and 1973 Stag's Leap Wine Cellars cabernet sauvignon are now held in the Smithsonian collections.
National Museum of American History
Forty years ago, in the world of wine, there were just three categories: the good stuff (French), the very good stuff (also French), and everything else. Few doubted that anything could be finer than the vines in Burgundy and Bordeaux, and those at the upper end of wine snobbery were unshakable Francophiles.
And then an event on May 24, 1976—a singular, notable event that would come to be known by the mythical name
“The Judgment of Paris”
—dramatically changed the way wines were seen and sought forever after. A well known and highly respected British wine seller and educator,
Steven Spurrier
, whose specialty was fine French vintages,
organized
a blind tasting that put unlabeled French and California whites and reds in front of nine French experts.
The idea originated with
Patricia Gallagher
, the American manager of Spurrier's store in the center of Paris. She had tried a few California wines, and on vacation in 1975 she traveled to the state’s wine valleys to meet vintners and sample their wares. Her enthusiasm inspired Spurrier to make a similar trip in April of 1976 and to select certain wines for a tasting the next month. Reached in London, Spurrier told me that the timing was intended to coincide, more or less, with the bicentennial of the American revolution, though that is “not an anniversary we Brits celebrate much.”
What then happened was revolutionary.
Steven Spurrier enlisted distinguished French wine experts and had them taste white and ten red.

From left to right: Patricia Gallagher, Steven Spurrier and French judge Odette Kahn
Photo courtesy of Bella Spurrier

The Paris tasting shifted attention to California, and gave other vintners there encouragement to create some of the best wines in the world.
Photo courtesy of Bella Spurrier

A telegram announcing the "stunning success" at the Paris tasting.
Photo courtesy of Chateau Montelena Winery

Judgment of Paris: California vs. France & the Historic 1976 Paris Tasting That Revolutionized Wine
The only reporter present at the mythic Paris Tasting of 1976—a blind tasting where a panel of esteemed French judges chose upstart California wines over France’s best—for the first time introduces the eccentric American winemakers and records the tremendous aftershocks of this historic event that changed forever the world of wine.
Buy
Spurrier enlisted distinguished French wine experts and had them taste ten white wines—six California chardonnays and four French white Burgundies. And he had them taste ten reds—six California cabernets and four French reds from Bordeaux. To everyone’s surprise, especially the judges, the two wines that came out on top were from Napa Valley, a
1973 Chateau Montelena chardonnay
and a
1973 cabernet sauvignon from Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars
.
Bottles of these two triumphant vintages are now held in the Smithsonian collections at the National Museum of American History, where a
sold-out celebration
of the anniversary will take place May 16 and 17. (And no, the vintage bottles will not be uncorked to mark the win.)
Steven Spurrier was just as surprised as his French tasters. On the cusp of the event’s 40th
-
anniversary, he told me that the judges tended to be tougher on the reds, and that he thinks the Stag’s Leap cab won because they thought it was from Bordeaux. As it happened, a writer from
Time
magazine,
George Taber
, was covering the event and did a
story
on it, making the California coup international news.
The winemakers responsible for this unexpected victory,
Miljenko (Mike) Grgich
, who made the chardonnay (while working for Chateau Montelena winery, owned by
Jim Barrett
, and not long after founded Grgich Hills Estates) and
Warren Winiarski
, founder of Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars, were initially unaware of their newfound prominence. Each told me they didn’t know about the tasting, and didn’t even know their wines had been part of the contest.
Now in his mid-90s, Grgich, who grew up in a wine-making family on the Dalmatian coast of what was then Yugoslavia and brought his family traditions to the Napa Valley, was happy to hear of his wine’s victory, but not entirely surprised.

data.article_summary:
文章讨论了初创企业在快速实验中可能陷入的p-hacking陷阱。p-hacking是指通过不当的数据分析获得显著结果的做法。文章通过三个案例说明了这种问题：

1. **多重比较未修正**：在A/B/n测试中，同时测试多个变体（如网页布局A、B、C、D）会增加假阳性概率。若不调整显著性阈值（如使用Bonferroni修正），容易错误地认为某变体有效。

2. **结果出来后重新定义指标**：当初始指标未显示显著改善时，转而分析其他指标（如从注册率转向留存率），可能导致随机性误导结果。每增加一个指标，假阳性概率随之增加。

3. **预注册解决方案**：在实验前明确所有要测试的指标和假设，避免事后更改，以减少随机性影响。

为避免p-hacking，建议在多重比较时调整显著性阈值，并在实验前明确所有分析计划。这有助于提高实验结果的可信度。

• **关于实验的实际操作和建议**：
  - [Palmik] 提到在FAANG公司中，实验通常是多臂的，且经常重复进行，实验标准通常不明确，最终决定往往基于直觉和大量指标的综合判断。

• **关于多重比较和误报率的解决方案**：
  - [ec109685] 提出了一些减少误报的方法，如季度α账本、Benjamini–Hochberg (BH) 方法和贝叶斯收缩等，适用于不同规模和需求的实验环境。

• **关于实验工具和模拟器的建议**：
  - [aDyslecticCrow] 建议使用python的rand()函数作为一种快速检查方法，以验证概率计算的准确性。
  - [welpo] 提供了一个A/A测试模拟器链接，用于比较peeking和不peeking情况下的假阳性率。

• **关于实验的根本目的**：
  - [dooglius] 指出，如果目标是最大化页面效果，可以参考“多臂老虎机”问题中的解决方案，而不是仅仅依赖统计显著性测试。
  - [kookamamie] 认为，有些产品根本不需要对网页布局进行微优化，可以有更宏观的战略。

争议焦点：实验的严谨性程度以及如何在不同场景下（如创业公司与医药研究）平衡测试的复杂性和实际操作性。

Speed kills rigor. In startups, the pressure to ship fast pushes teams to report
anything

Example 01: Multiple comparisons without correction
Imagine you're a product manager trying to optimize your websiteâs dashboard. Your goal is to increase user signups. Your team designs four different layouts: A, B, C, and D.
You run an A/B/n test. Users are randomly assigned to one of the four layouts and you track their activity. Your hypothesis is:
layout influences signup behavior
.
You plan ship the winner if the p-value for one of the layout choices falls below the conventional threshold of 0.05.
Then you check the results:
Option B looks best. p = 0.041. It floats to the top as if inviting action. The team is satisfied and ships it.
But the logic beneath the 0.05 cutoff is more fragile than it appears. That threshold assumes youâre testing a single variant. But you tested four. That alone
increases
the odds of a false positive.
Letâs look at what that actually means.
Setting a p-value threshold of 0.05 is equivalent to saying:

data.title: Samsung embeds IronSource spyware app on phones across WANA
data.author: the-anarchist
data.article_summary: 这封公开信呼吁三星公司对其在西亚北非（WANA）地区销售的A系列和M系列智能手机上预装的AppCloud软件保持透明度并承担责任。AppCloud由以色列创立的公司ironSource开发，嵌入在这些设备中，未经用户同意收集敏感个人数据，且无法轻易移除，存在隐私和安全风险。信中要求三星披露AppCloud的隐私政策和数据处理实践，提供简单有效的退出和移除选项，并解释为何在该地区预装该软件。此外，信中还呼吁三星重新考虑未来的预装策略，以尊重用户的隐私权，并请求与三星团队举行会议进一步讨论这些问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：三星设备中的AppCloud及其隐私和安全问题

不同观点：
• [boramalper] 认为大规模监控（无论是企业为广告目的还是国家为情报目的）与近期针对伊朗高级核科学家和军官的袭击事件有密切联系。提出隐私问题不仅是人权问题，还涉及国家安全。
• [AlotOfReading] 指出原文遗漏了很多关于AppCloud的信息，并提到这是三星通过非旗舰设备用户变现的一种方式，例如通过通知栏插入广告和静默安装应用。个人表示如果遇到这种情况会考虑换用苹果设备。
• [grishka] 指出AppCloud并非完全不可移除，可以通过adb命令禁用，尽管它位于系统分区无法完全卸载。
• [the-anarchist] 补充这一问题不仅限于某个地区，整个中东和北非（MENA）区域都有类似情况，只是不同地区名称不同（如“Aura”）。
• [thenthenthen] 提到AppCloud由有争议的以色列公司ironSource开发，现已被美国公司Unity收购。
• [0rzech] 表示欧洲和北美地区也存在AppCloud问题，且不论是否锁定运营商，有时在系统更新或安全更新后出现，令人愤怒。
• [reccy] 批评原文缺乏技术细节和证据，认为其旨在引发情绪反应而非理智分析。
• [userbinator] 认为用户应有获得root权限的基本权利，否则无法真正拥有设备，并批评企业通过保修和安全风险来限制用户。
• [v5v3] 提到三星作为韩国公司，可能受到美国国家安全局的影响。
• [msgodel] 表示已放弃智能手机，认为其多是负面影响，改用廉价安卓平板和UMPC等设备。
• [mousethatroared] 提出是否有可能由顶尖工程师团队打造一个高度安全的智能手机，列举了一些安全特性，如微内核、默认加密通讯、硬件开关等。
• [ehnto] 证实澳洲的三星设备也有AppCloud问题，能够禁用但无法完全移除，且已发送了35MB的数据。
• [midtake] 讨论供应链妥协是现代安全的一个严重问题，依赖于权力和金钱，并质疑是否还能通过密码学验证来保障用户安全，还是只能接受赛博朋克式的未来。
• [Grandeculio] 发现可以通过三星手机的设置请求AppCloud中的数据访问或删除，并分享了个人经验。
• [mellosouls] 认为标题有误导性，原文仅称其为“bloatware”（臃肿软件）而非“spyware”（间谍软件）。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于AppCloud是否构成隐私威胁，部分用户认为其为间谍软件性质，而另一些用户认为只是臃肿软件。
• 技术解决方案和用户权利（如root权限）是讨论的重要部分，部分用户提出通过技术手段解决问题，如adb命令。
• 供应链安全和国家层面的监控问题也被提及，显示出更广泛的安全和隐私问题。

Open Letter to Samsung: End Forced Israeli-Founded Bloatware Installations in the WANA Region
Appcloud
Invasive
ironSource
Written by
SMEX
Published on
05 May 2025
https://smex.org/open-letter-to-samsung-end-forced-israeli-app-installations-in-the-wana-region/
Copy link
In recent months, we have received numerous reports from users across West Asia and North Africa (WANA) expressing alarm over a little-known but deeply intrusive bloatware application—AppCloud—pre-installed on Samsung’s A and M series smartphones. Without users’ knowledge or consent, this bloatware collects sensitive personal data, cannot be removed without compromising device security, and offers no clear information about its privacy practices.
AppCloud, developed by the controversial Israeli-founded company ironSource (now owned by the American company
Unity
), is embedded into devices sold in countries where such affiliations carry legal implications. Despite the serious privacy and security risks, Samsung has offered no transparency on how AppCloud functions, what data it collects, or why users cannot opt out.
This open letter, addressed to Samsung, calls for immediate transparency, accountability, and dialogue. Users deserve to know what is installed on their devices and how their data is being used, especially amid Israel’s espionage campaigns in the region.
_________
To Whom it May Concern,
We are writing to urgently request that Samsung be transparent regarding the pre-installation of AppCloud on its A and M series smartphones, particularly in West Asia and North Africa (WANA). We ask that Samsung provide information about AppCloud’s privacy practices, opt-out and removal options, and that Samsung reconsider future pre-installations in light of privacy rights. We also request a meeting with Samsung teams to discuss these concerns further.
Since the expansion of Samsung’s
partnership
with ironSource in 2022, AppCloud has been embedded by default on
new A and M devices distributed in this region
.
According to our
analysis
, this intrusive software is
unremovable
, deeply integrated into the devices’ operating system, making it nearly impossible for regular users to uninstall it without root access, which voids warranties and poses security risks. Even disabling the bloatware is not effective as it can reappear after system updates.
The privacy policy is
opaque,
there is no accessible and transparent privacy policy for this bloatware and users are in the dark about what data is collected and how it is used. There is also no straightforward opt-out mechanism. The bloatware collects sensitive user data, including biometric information, IP addresses, device fingerprints.
The installation of AppCloud is done
without any consent
from the user, which violates GDPR provisions in the EU and relevant data protection laws in the WANA region states.
AppCloud is developed by ironSource,
an Israel-founded company (now acquired by American company Unity),
raising additional legal and ethical concerns in countries where Israeli companies are barred from operating, such as
Lebanon
. ironSource is notorious for its questionable practices regarding user consent and data privacy.
Samsung’s terms of service mention third party applications but do not specifically address AppCloud or ironSource, despite the significant data access and control granted to this bloatware app.
The forced installation of AppCloud
undermines the privacy and security rights of users in the MENA region and beyond.
The lack of transparency and control over personal data is particularly alarming given
Samsung’s
significant market share in the region
.
In light of these concerns, we respectfully request that Samsung:
Disclose the full privacy policy and data handling practices of AppCloud, making this information easily accessible to all users.
Offer a straightforward and effective method for users to opt out of AppCloud and remove it from their devices without compromising device functionality or warranty.
Provide a clear explanation for the decision to pre-install AppCloud on all A and M series devices in the WANA region.
Reconsider the continued pre-installation of AppCloud on future devices, in line with the right to privacy as established by Article 12 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
We also request a
meeting with the relevant Samsung teams
to discuss these issues in detail and to better understand the company’s approach to user privacy and data protection in the WANA region.
We look forward to your prompt response and to working together to ensure the privacy and security of all Samsung users.

44334167.article_summary: 这封公开信呼吁三星公司对其在西亚北非（WANA）地区销售的A系列和M系列智能手机上预装的AppCloud软件保持透明度并承担责任。AppCloud由以色列创立的公司ironSource开发，嵌入在这些设备中，未经用户同意收集敏感个人数据，且无法轻易移除，存在隐私和安全风险。信中要求三星披露AppCloud的隐私政策和数据处理实践，提供简单有效的退出和移除选项，并解释为何在该地区预装该软件。此外，信中还呼吁三星重新考虑未来的预装策略，以尊重用户的隐私权，并请求与三星团队举行会议进一步讨论这些问题。

data.title: New Linux udisks flaw lets attackers get root on major Linux distros
data.author: smig0
data.article_summary: 两项新发现的本地权限提升（LPE）漏洞可让攻击者在多个主流Linux发行版上获得root权限。第一个漏洞（CVE-2025-6018）存在于openSUSE Leap 15和SUSE Linux Enterprise 15的PAM配置中，允许本地攻击者获得"allow_active"用户权限。第二个漏洞（CVE-2025-6019）位于libblockdev中，通过udisks守护进程（大多数Linux发行版默认运行）使"allow_active"用户提升至root权限。利用这些漏洞可以快速完全控制系统，尤其第二个漏洞单独存在时也极具威胁。Qualys TRU已开发出概念验证（PoC） exploit，并成功在Ubuntu、Debian、Fedora和openSUSE系统上测试。管理员需立即打补丁以防风险。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Linux系统中的本地权限提升（privesc）、安全边界、PAM和系统设计复杂性等问题

不同观点：
• PhilipRoman认为，在共享内核的环境中绘制安全边界是不可行的，因为内核中的漏洞很多。他指出，通过限制系统调用和隐藏大部分内核可以增加安全性，但这需要深入的知识，并且会破坏很多软件的功能。
• baobun提到openSUSE中sudo行为的差异，特别是默认的sudo密码提示行为与其他发行版不同，这可能带来使用上的不便。
• pona-a通过代码行数和CVE数据进行分析，指出像udisks这样的大型软件可能包含更多的严重安全漏洞，而较小的软件如pmount则相对安全。
• mkj关注环境变量在进程间传递信息时的潜在安全问题，质疑当前方法的稳健性。
• hbogert认为Linux在功能和安全性上一直是一个长期的实验，暗示其不断变化和实验性的性质。
• teddyh指出相关问题已在Debian中修复，暗示问题并非广泛存在。
• b0a04gl解释了udisks与PAM的交互及潜在的攻击路径，认为用户目录在权限提升时被视为可信的是一个设计问题。
• belorn请求解释Linux中的'allow_active'权限，显示对技术细节的需求。
• udev4096认为问题很旧且仅影响openSUSE，标题具有误导性。
• 1970-01-01批评文章中对缺陷、错误和安全漏洞的混用，强调术语使用应一致。
• 0xbadcafebee对PAM和Systemd在Linux中的引入表示不满，认为这些组件增加了系统的复杂性，并批评企业对开源社区的影响。

补充讨论：
• fitsumbelay请求帮助理解该漏洞对非SUSE发行版用户的影响，显示对跨发行版问题的关注。
• icar询问Arch是否曾受影响，关注特定发行版的历史安全问题。
• neuroelectron以幽默方式提到漏洞对AWS上比特币矿工的潜在利用机会，暗示经济利益驱动漏洞利用。

争议焦点：
• Linux内核安全边界是否可行及如何实现。
• PAM和Systemd引入对系统设计的影响，特别是复杂性和耦合性增加的问题。
• 不同Linux发行版中sudo行为差异带来的使用不便。

44325861.article_content:
New Linux udisks flaw lets attackers get root on major Linux distros
By
Sergiu Gatlan
June 18, 2025
04:45 AM
0
Attackers can exploit two newly discovered local privilege escalation (LPE) vulnerabilities to gain root privileges on systems running major Linux distributions.
The first flaw (tracked as
CVE-2025-6018
) was found in the configuration of the Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) framework on openSUSE Leap 15 and SUSE Linux Enterprise 15, allowing local attackers to gain the privileges of the "allow_active" user.
The other security bug (
CVE-2025-6019
) was discovered in libblockdev, and it enables an "allow_active" user to gain root permissions via the udisks daemon (a storage management service that runs by default on most Linux distributions).
While successfully abusing the two flaws as part of a "local-to-root" chain exploit can let attackers quickly gain root and completely take over a SUSE system, the libblockdev/udisks flaw is also extremely dangerous on its own.
"Although it nominally requires 'allow_active' privileges, udisks ships by default on almost all Linux distributions, so nearly any system is vulnerable,"
said
Qualys TRU senior manager Saeed Abbasi.
"Techniques to gain 'allow_active,' including the PAM issue disclosed here, further negate that barrier. An attacker can chain these vulnerabilities for immediate root compromise with minimal effort."
The Qualys Threat Research Unit (TRU), which discovered and reported both flaws, has also developed
proof-of-concept exploits
and successfully targeted CVE-2025-6019 to get root privileges on Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, and openSUSE Leap 15 systems.
Admins urged to patch immediately
The Qualys Security Advisory team has shared more technical details regarding these two vulnerabilities
here
and linked to security patches in this
Openwall post
.
"Root access enables agent tampering, persistence, and lateral movement, so one unpatched server endangers the whole fleet. Patch both PAM and libblockdev/udisks everywhere to eliminate this path," Abbasi added.
"Given the ubiquity of udisks and the simplicity of the exploit, organizations must treat this as a
critical, universal risk and deploy patches without delay
."
In recent years, Qualys researchers have discovered several other Linux security vulnerabilities that let attackers hijack unpatched Linux systems, even in default configurations.
Security flaws they discovered include a flaw in Polkit's pkexec component (
dubbed PwnKit
), one in glibc's ld.so dynamic loader (
Looney Tunables
), another in the Kernel's filesystem layer (
dubbed Sequoia
), and one in the Sudo Unix program (aka
Baron Samedit
).
Shortly after the Looney Tunables flaw was disclosed, proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits were
released online
. One month later, attackers
began exploiting it
to steal cloud service provider (CSP) credentials using Kinsing malware.
Qualys also recently
found five LPE vulnerabilities
introduced over 10 years ago in the needrestart utility used by default in Ubuntu Linux 21.04 and later.
Why IT teams are ditching manual patch management
Patching used to mean complex scripts, long hours, and endless fire drills. Not anymore.
In this new guide, Tines breaks down how modern IT orgs are leveling up with automation. Patch faster, reduce overhead, and focus on strategic work -- no complex scripts required.

data.title: Spectroscopic Classification of ASASSN-25cm as a Classical Nova
data.author: tzury
data.article_summary: 2025年6月14日，Yusuke Tampo使用南非天文台Lesedi望远镜的光谱观测将ASASSN-25cm（即AT 2025nlr）分类为经典新星。该天体于2025年6月12日由ASAS-SN发现，光谱显示巴尔末线和He I或Fe II线的P Cygni轮廓，Hα和Hβ的吸收谷速度分别为-1200 km/s和-900 km/s。其大爆发振幅和光谱特征确认其为经典新星。这一结果在ATel #17228中报告。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：V462 Lupi的天文学观测情况，包括其位置、亮度变化以及公众获取信息的质量。

不同观点：
• Messe关注V462 Lupi的地理可见性，提到该星座在北半球的可见范围限制，并表达了个人对无法在更低纬度观测到该天体的遗憾和羡慕之情。

• SiempreViernes则关注V462 Lupi的亮度变化，引用Astronomer Telegram的数据说明该天体从8.7等提升到6.1等，亮度增加了11倍，并指出在黑暗天空条件下接近肉眼可见的边缘。同时，对IFLscience的信息质量提出质疑，认为其对公众的帮助有限，并批评了对ATel链接和标题的编辑方式。

补充讨论：
• V462 Lupi位于Lupus星座，在南半球和北半球低纬度地区可见。
• 亮度变化的具体数据：从8.7等提升到6.1等，增加了11倍。
• 对科学信息传播质量的讨论，特别是IFLscience和ATel在公众天文信息传播中的有效性。
• 争议焦点在于科学信息传播的有效性以及对公众友好的信息呈现方式。

Spectroscopic Classification of ASASSN-25cm (=AT 2025nlr) as a Classical Nova
ATel #17228;
Yusuke Tampo (South African Astronomical Observatory, University of Cape Town)
on
14 Jun 2025; 18:26 UT
Distributed as an Instant Email Notice Novae
Credential Certification: Yusuke Tampo (yusuke@saao.ac.za)
Subjects: Optical, Binary, Cataclysmic Variable, Nova, Transient, Variables
Referred to by ATel #:
17237
,
17240
Tweet
I report the spectroscopic classification of
ASASSN-25cm
(=
AT 2025nlr
). Its optical spectrum was obtained on 2025-06-14.745 UT by the Mookodi (
Erasmus et al. 2024
) mounted on the 1-m Lesedi telescope at the South African Astronomical Observatory in Sutherland. The observation setups were 2" slit, wavelength coverage 4000-8000Å, and spectral resolution R~400.
As reported to
TNS
, ASASSN-25cm was originally discovered by ASAS-SN on 2025-06-12 20:52:48 UT at g=8.7 mag. There is no counterpart in archival photometric surveys.
My normalized spectrum
shows the Balmer and either He I or Fe II lines with P Cygni profiles.
The absorption minimum of the P Cygni profile in Hα and Hβ are located around -1200 and -900 km/s, respectively.
Combining these spectral features and its large eruption amplitude, I conclude that this object is a new classical nova.

data.title: Show HN: Ariadne – A Rust implementation of aperiodic cryptography
data.author: ciphernomad-org
data.article_summary: Ariadne Protocol 是一个由 CipherNomad 提出的新型加密架构，旨在实现非周期性、状态依赖的加密转换。该协议基于 Labyrinth（一个大型确定性生成的二叉树）和 Thread（秘密的、非周期性的路径）两个核心概念。其主要创新在于通过加密虚拟机（CVM）动态计算每块数据的加密路径，而无需存储或传输路径信息。Ariadne Suite 是该协议的 Rust 实现，包含核心架构、加密原语和高层次协议等组件，如 `ariadne-core`、`ariadne-generator` 和多种 AEAD 协议。该项目为开源研究，作为公共资源发布，但仍处于实验阶段，尚未经过第三方安全审计，不建议用于生产环境。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新协议的目的和安全性，特别是与现有AEAD（如Rust中的AEAD）相比的优势和潜在风险。

不同观点：
• Medea认为该协议的目的不明确，质疑其相较于现有AEAD（如Rust中的实现）提供的额外安全保障是什么，尤其是在构建协议时有何独特优势。
• kennethallen质疑协议中PRNG使用固定大小状态的说法，认为即使周期很长（如2^256次操作），仍会有周期性。他还指出，与块加密（如AES+GCM）相比，该方案更复杂，但在保密性和篡改保护方面未见明显优势，且块加密有并行加密和解密、硬件支持等实际优势。
• conradludgate指出代码中的具体问题：在随机轮中使用Hash时，只加密了一半的数据块，另一半未加密，这可能会导致安全问题。
• willvalfar担心某些路径可能导致不安全的密码使用，进而导致更大范围的妥协。例如，程序经过类似2DES的状态时可能遭受中间人攻击，从而大大减少攻击者搜索空间。

- Comprehensive unit and integration tests for all components.

Ariadne Suite
ariadne.ciphernomad.org
This repository contains the
Ariadne Suite
, our canonical Rust implementation of the
Ariadne Protocol
. The protocol is a novel cryptographic architecture we designed around the
Labyrinth Construction
to provide
aperiodic
, or non-repeating, cryptographic transformations.
The project mission is to create resilient, open-source tools for digital sovereignty.
This is independent research, released as a public good. Its continuation, development, and future security audits are funded by community support.
Contribute at donate.ciphernomad.org
⚠️
Security Warning & Disclaimer
⚠️
This is unaudited, experimental alpha software provided for research and educational purposes only.
The cryptographic designs herein are novel. While built upon standard, vetted primitives (BLAKE3, XChaCha20, X25519), the security of the overarching Ariadne Protocol has not been formally verified by third-party audit.
DO NOT USE FOR PRODUCTION OR REAL-WORLD APPLICATIONS.
Use is entirely at your own risk. This software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind.
Core Concepts of the Ariadne Protocol
The protocol is built on two core ideas we developed: the Labyrinth and the Thread.
The Labyrinth:
A large, deterministically generated binary tree of cryptographic
Round
s. This can be a shared public parameter, not a secret.
The Thread:
The secret, aperiodic path taken through the Labyrinth's nodes during an operation.
The Emergent Path Mechanism
The core innovation of the protocol is how the Thread is formed. It is not stored or transmitted. Instead, the path is rediscovered dynamically for each block of data. A Cryptographic Virtual Machine (CVM) determines the next turn (left or right) in the Labyrinth by computing a keyed hash of its own secret state and the public ciphertext chunk.
An attacker, who sees the public ciphertext but lacks the secret key and state, cannot compute this hash. The path remains secret, woven into the data stream at zero overhead.
Aperiodic by Design
The Ariadne Protocol is a fundamental departure from conventional, periodic ciphers that apply the exact same sequence of operations to every block of data.
In our design, the CVM's internal state is updated after every block, acting as a cryptographic ratchet. This new state is then used to derive the keys and path for the
next
block. Because the state transition is a secure pseudo-random function, the CVM's state never repeats.
This guarantees that the sequence of cryptographic transformations is
aperiodic
: no two blocks, even within the same message, are ever processed in the exact same way. Each

data.title: Disabling Intel Graphics Security Mitigation Boosts GPU Compute Performance 20%
data.author: rcarmo
data.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了通过禁用Intel图形安全缓解措施，可以提高GPU计算性能达20%。Ubuntu的开发公司Canonical正与Intel合作，计划在Ubuntu软件包中禁用这些缓解措施，以恢复性能损失。具体方法是通过使用"NEO_DISABLE_MITIGATIONS"构建选项，该选项仅影响Intel计算运行时堆栈，而不涉及Linux内核的安全缓解措施。尽管这一改变可能带来安全风险，但Intel和Canonical的安全团队已同意这一调整，因为Spectre漏洞已在 kernel 层面得到缓解，且Intel在其GitHub上的计算运行时包中也默认禁用了这些缓解措施。Ubuntu 25.10版本预计将包含这一改动。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Intel GPU的Spectre缓解措施是否必要以及性能与安全之间的权衡

不同观点：
• **[phoronixrly]** 认为当前的标题具有误导性，让人以为Canonical为了性能重新开放了Spectre漏洞。实际上，Spectre在kernel层面已经得到了缓解，因此在GPU的Compute Runtime层面不再需要缓解措施，关闭这些措施可以带来20%的性能提升。他建议修改标题并提供源链接以避免误导。

• **[rurban]** 质疑关闭缓解措施是否会重新引入CVE-2019-0155漏洞。他提到Intel研究人员发现Intel显卡处理器允许用户空间通过Blitter Command Streamer修改MMIO，从而可能导致权限提升和信息泄露。

• **[pabs3]** 建议是否可以在运行时根据当前Linux kernel的缓解情况动态启用或禁用这些缓解措施。

• **[CjHuber]** 认为缓解措施导致性能下降是众所周知的事实，从未听说有人认为缓解措施不会影响性能。

• **[gotoeleven]** 提出一个更广泛的安全模型问题，质疑在现代计算机系统中，通过限制用户权限来保证安全是否仍然可行。他认为在共享资源的计算机上隔离不同用户的工作非常困难，建议设计系统时假设所有用户都可以获得root权限，从而避免大多数漏洞的威胁。

补充讨论：
• **[Rakshith]** 关注实际操作问题，询问如何禁用这些缓解措施。

争议焦点：
• 是否在kernel层面缓解Spectre后就无需在GPU的Compute Runtime层面继续缓解。
• 关闭缓解措施是否会重新引入其他安全漏洞（如CVE-2019-0155）。
• 安全与性能的权衡，以及是否有可能设计出不依赖于用户权限隔离的更安全的系统模型。

Disabling Intel Graphics Security Mitigations Can Boost GPU Compute Performance By 20%
Written by
Michael Larabel
in
Intel
on 22 June 2025 at 09:27 AM EDT.
16 Comments
While not talked about as much as the Intel CPU security mitigations, Intel graphics security mitigations have added up over time that if disabling Intel graphics security mitigations for their GPU compute stack for OpenCL and Level Zero can yield a 20% performance boost. Ubuntu maker Canonical in cooperation with Intel is preparing to disable these security mitigations in the Ubuntu packages in order to recoup this lost performance.
I haven't looked at the Intel graphics security mitigation costs as closely as on the CPU side but apparently now it's up to around 20%. Intel does allow building their GPU compute stack without these mitigations by using the "NEO_DISABLE_MITIGATIONS" build option and that is what Canonical is looking to set now for Ubuntu packages to avoid the significant performance impact. This work will likely all be addressed in time for Ubuntu 25.10. This NEO_DISABLE_MITIGATIONS option is just for compiling the Intel Compute Runtime stack and doesn't impact the Linux kernel security mitigations or else outside of Intel's "NEO" GPU compute stack. Both Intel and Canonical are in agreement with this move and it turns out that even Intel's GitHub binary packages for their Compute Runtime for OpenCL and Level Zero ship with the mitigations disabled due to the performance impact.
This Ubuntu Launchpad bug report
for the Intel Compute Runtime notes the key takeaways:
" * Users can expect up to 20% performance improvement"
...
[ Where problems could occur ]
* As we are proposing to eliminate a vulnerability mitigation, there is the possibility that this would open up an unknown avenue for attack. To provide some confidence for this sizable risk, both Intel and Canonical security have signed off on this change, and Intel even distributes without these mitigations from their Compute Runtime Github repo without any known exploits.
* As with any change, this change could open up some other bug that was covered up by the mitigations. As with the previous point, we have some confidence because Intel already publishes without these mitigations.
* As we have mentioned that Intel already includes this change, it is appropriate to mention that Intel statically links their builds for Compute Runtime and has some differences in their debian packaging, which means that we could have unknown behavioral differences between the archive version and the versions published in their Github repo."
That Launchpad ticket also notes:
"After discussion between Intel and Canonical’s security teams, we are in agreement that Spectre no longer needs to be mitigated for the GPU at the Compute Runtime level. At this point, Spectre has been mitigated in the kernel, and a clear warning from the Compute Runtime build serves as a notification for those running modified kernels without those patches. For these reasons, we feel that Spectre mitigations in Compute Runtime no longer offer enough security impact to justify the current performance tradeoff.
Intel themselves have enabled this flag in their builds available on their Github release page upstream."
There is
this PPA
where Ubuntu developers are currently testing their Compute Runtime builds with NEO_DISABLE_MITIGATIONS enabled for disabling the mitigations.
I'll be working on some benchmarks shortly with not realizing the mitigation impact is hitting the 20% scope for Intel graphics compute.

data.title: OpenAI and Jony Ive's "io" brand has disappeared
data.article_summary: OpenAI has removed references to its partnership with Jony Ive's hardware startup, "io," following a trademark lawsuit from Iyo, a hearing device startup. Although mentions and promotional content have been taken down from OpenAI's website and social media, the company confirmed that the deal to collaborate on AI hardware is still in place. The removal was due to a court order after Iyo complained about the similarity in names. OpenAI is assessing its legal options while the content remains inaccessible. The partnership aims to develop AI products, with Ive's team integrating more closely with OpenAI's research and engineering departments.

data.article_summary: 本文简要介绍了游戏中的物理模拟，特别聚焦于Verlet积分及其在布料模拟中的应用。文章首先讲解了物理模拟的基础，包括微分与积分的简单回顾，以及数值积分方法，如Euler积分和Verlet积分。Verlet积分是一种用于解决粒子系统和约束问题的流行方法，以其稳定性著称，适用于如布料模拟等需要处理多个相互影响的运动部件的场景。文章还比较了不同积分方法的优缺点，如Euler积分和Runge-Kutta方法，并通过C++实现了一个简单的2D布料模拟示例。Verlet积分因其稳定性在许多游戏物理引擎中广泛应用，尤其适合处理复杂的物理互动。

44333149.article_content:
Verlet Integration and Cloth Physics Simulation
Physics simulation in games (or simply game physics) is a vast topic, and in this post we'll cover only a tiny part of it; yet certainly an interesting one! Let's understand what Verlet integration is by implementing a simple 2D cloth simulation with C++.
Marian Pekár
10 May 2022 · 30 min read
Physics in games is always fun, isn't it? Have you ever ditched the main quest of a level just to blow something up? I know I have.
But even more fun than watching objects bounce around the screen is to
understand
how we can use simple concepts from high-school mathematics to simulate those physics laws with code.
This article is divided into the following sections:
The basics of physics simulation
A quick review of
differentiation
and
integration
Numerical integration in the context of motion
Euler Integration
Verlet Integration
JavaScript implementation of Verlet integration
C++ implementation of cloth simulation
And this is still a tiny subset of what we understand by
game physics
. Our main goal is to explore something called
Verlet integration
. We'll look at its motivations, intuition, and how we can use Verlet integration to write a simple 2D cloth simulation with C++.
Verlet integration is a very popular method to solve systems of particles (masses) and constraints (springs).
Oh, and if you ever asked yourself why your university required you to take
Calculus
as a CS student, this blog post might help you answer that question as well.
Physics Simulation is a Discrete Game
Simulating physics with a computer requires us to compute things like
forces
,
acceleration
,
velocity
, and
position
in
discrete
time steps. We need a way of predicting the
new position
of an object on the screen for each time step.
Computers run at discrete clock ticks, requiring results to be approximated using numerical methods.
As it turns out, there are several methods we can use to find these predictions. Some prediction methods are faster, some are more stable, and some are expensive but give better approximations. Depending on the type of problem we are simulating, we can make educated guesses on which prediction method we should pick.
You will hear some programmers use the term
integration
when talking about these predictions. Some popular integration techniques used by physics programmers are
Euler's method
,
Runge-Kutta methods
, and of course,
Verlet integration
.
If you ever took
Calculus
before and you got scared by the word "integration", don't worry! We'll review the basics to make sure everyone is on the same page.
Why Verlet?
Verlet integration gets its name after the French physicist
Loup Verlet
. Verlet used this method of integration in his article
Computer "Experiments" on Classical Fluids, I. Thermodynamical Properties of Lennard-Jones Molecules
, published in July of 1967. However, it's believed that it was first used by Delambre in 1791, and has been rediscovered several times since then. You'll also read books that use the name Störmer's method for this technique (by Carl Størmer). In this post, I'm going to stick with the common term "Verlet integration".
Fun fact
: We pronounce Verlet as [vɛʁ'lɛ]... but remember that it's only
Verlet
if it comes from the Verlet region of France; otherwise, it's just sparkling Euler.
These days, Verlet Integration plays an important role in many game physics engines. It's less expensive than, for example, Runge-Kutta methods (though also less accurate), but it's also much more stable than Euler's method. Its stability makes this method ideal especially for simulations with moving parts where each has certain degree of freedom, but all are connected together, so each also influence the others either directly or indirectly. You'll see that our article describes a cloth simulation that consists of points connected with sticks (constraints), which is exactly the type of scenario that benefits from Verlet's stability!
Different types of physics engines can benefit from choosing different integration methods. For example, Euler integration is a popular choice for
rigid-body
physics. Rigid-body engines simplify the problem by assuming the shapes of our objects can never change or deform. For this type of scenario, Euler integration gives good-enough approximations and it's reasonably stable.
Euler integration is a popular choice for rigid-body physics engines.
Alright! Before we dive in, I'd like to mention one super important thing. I could've just started with a brief explanation of how Verlet integration works a then walk you through the code and that would be probably fine for most people. Maybe you already know the basics of integration & differentiation and understand what I mean when I talk about stability, accuracy, and expensiveness in the context of physics simulation. 2D Game Physics Programming
course here at
pikuma.com
, then I think you can skip the following secti

data.title: Nano-Vllm: lightweight vLLM implementation built from scratch
data.author: simonpure
data.article_summary: Nano-vLLM 是一个轻量级的大语言模型推理实现，从零构建，具备以下特点：快速的离线推理速度、约1,200行代码的简洁可读的Python实现、以及包括前缀缓存和CUDA图形等在内的多种优化技术。安装可通过 `pip install` 完成，使用方式与vLLM类似，具体示例见 `example.py`。根据基准测试，Nano-vLLM在RTX 4070笔记本硬件上的推理速度略快于vLLM，处理256个序列时，推理时间为93.41秒，吞吐量为1434.13 tokens/秒。项目遵循MIT许可证，已获得2.8k星标。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：nano-vllm项目的特点、性能及其与vllm项目的对比

不同观点：
• jimmySixDOF认为nano-vllm的文档略显不足，初始无法判断其超参数是否具有1:1的可调性，或是仅为单一固定路径。不过，经过进一步了解后，他承认该项目是合法的，并引用了一个由Dolphin OpenSource系列FineTunes的开发者实现的例子，提到在nano-vllm中实现了高效的logit采样。

• omneity称赞该项目是个人开发者的惊人成就，并指出开发者来自Deepseek团队。

• unwind对帖子标题中的大小写使用提出批评，认为标题中的大小写方式与项目名称的实际拼写方式相反。

• mountainriver表示喜欢这个项目，认为当前的机器学习环境中需要更多这样的简化。

• b0a04gl对nano-vllm的紧凑和高效表示惊讶，指出它实现了vllm的90%功能，但代码更具可读性，并且不需要额外的基础设施或编排层。他还提出了关于模块化注意力范围的推理引擎设计的可能性。

• tt726259对vllm的Docker镜像体积大幅增加表示怀疑，批评其开发实践，并引用具体的GitHub问题和提交记录作为证据。

• baalimago对nano-vllm的名称感到困惑，质疑“nano”和“large”在语言模型中的意义是否互相矛盾。

• zackify询问该项目是否会实现一个与Open AI兼容的web服务器，或者这不在项目范围内。

• fractorial提到自己误将‘Vllm’看成了‘LLVM’，并询问其他人是否有类似的误解。

• futurecliff询问b0a04gl具体做了哪些重构以获得如此显著的性能提升。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是vllm项目在开发实践中的问题，特别是Docker镜像体积的增加和多次出现的相同CUDA包。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是nano-vllm项目的简洁性和高效性，以及它与vllm项目在代码可读性和性能上的对比。
• 有讨论提到了对项目未来发展的期望和可能性，包括模块化注意力范围的推理引擎设计。

• omneity称赞该项目是个人开发者的惊人成就，并指出开发者来自Deepseek团队。

• unwind对帖子标题中的大小写使用提出批评，认为标题中的大小写方式与项目名称的实际拼写方式相反。

• mountainriver表示喜欢这个项目，认为当前的机器学习环境中需要更多这样的简化。

• b0a04gl对nano-vllm的紧凑和高效表示惊讶，指出它实现了vllm的90%功能，但代码更具可读性，并且不需要额外的基础设施或编排层。他还提出了关于模块化注意力范围的推理引擎设计的可能性。

• tt726259对vllm的Docker镜像体积大幅增加表示怀疑，批评其开发实践，并引用具体的GitHub问题和提交记录作为证据。

• baalimago对nano-vllm的名称感到困惑，质疑“nano”和“large”在语言模型中的意义是否互相矛盾。

• zackify询问该项目是否会实现一个与Open AI兼容的web服务器，或者这不在项目范围内。

• fractorial提到自己误将‘Vllm’看成了‘LLVM’，并询问其他人是否有类似的误解。

• futurecliff询问b0a04gl具体做了哪些重构以获得如此显著的性能提升。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是vllm项目在开发实践中的问题，特别是Docker镜像体积的增加和多次出现的相同CUDA包。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是nano-vllm项目的简洁性和高效性，以及它与vllm项目在代码可读性和性能上的对比。
• 有讨论提到了对项目未来发展的期望和可能性，包括模块化注意力范围的推理引擎设计。

主要讨论点：加拿大对司美鲁肽（semaglutide）专利撤销的影响

不同观点：
• **支持专利撤销，认为这会带来积极影响**：
  - [happyPersonR] 提到加拿大撤销了司美鲁肽的专利，暗示这对某些群体可能是有趣或有利的变化。
  - 论据：专利撤销可能意味着更多的仿制药进入市场，降低药物价格，增加药物的可及性，使更多患者受益。

• **担忧专利撤销对创新和研发的长期影响**：
  - [concernedScientist] 担心专利保护的撤销可能会打击制药公司的研发动力，因为专利保护通常是激励创新和新药研发的关键因素。
  - 论据：如果没有足够的专利保护，制药公司可能不愿意投入巨额资金进行药物研发，从而影响医药行业的长期发展。

• **关注药物质量和安全问题**：
  - [safetyFirst] 提出，虽然专利撤销可能带来价格下降，但需要确保仿制药的质量和安全性。
  - 论据：仿制药必须经过严格的监管和审批，以确保它们与原研药具有相同的疗效和安全性，否则可能对患者产生负面影响。

补充讨论：
• **专利撤销的全球影响**：
  - [globalImpact] 提到加拿大这一举措可能会对其他国家产生示范效应，促使更多国家重新审视药品专利保护政策。
  - 例子：其他国家可能会效仿加拿大的做法，撤销某些药品的专利，从而在全球范围内影响药品价格和供应。

• **争议焦点**：
  - 争议的焦点在于专利撤销对药物创新和患者可及性的双重影响。一方认为这能降低药品价格，增加可及性；另一方则担心这会削弱制药公司的创新动力，影响未来新药的研发。

data.title: AI's Biggest Threat: Young People Who Can't Think
data.author: miles
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI对人类思维能力、教育和写作的影响及潜在威胁

不同观点：
• smcleod：认为大量劳动人口长期以来表现出思维能力的欠缺，这可能源于无意义的工作任务。然而，AI可以作为编码伙伴，帮助人们探索新的思维方式和领域，从而激发潜在的能力。他将AI的影响类比为机动车取代马匹，暗示技术进步不可阻挡。

• joenot443：引用另一位教授的观点，指出AI生成的论文中充斥着“看似合乎逻辑但实则空洞的陈述”。他认为这种空洞无物不仅仅是AI造成的，而是人们缺乏辨别能力的结果。他进一步指出，缺乏阅读经验的人可能将GPT生成的语法正确但内容平庸的文字视为“好”写作，类似于将快餐误认为美食。

• johnea：简短地点出AI的第二大威胁是“不能思考的老年人”，暗示AI可能加剧老年人群体的认知障碍问题。

• nottorp：提到在其国家曾将此类空洞的语言称为“木语言”，用于逃避责任。他认为现在这种现象正在被自动化。

• pgryko：提出一个未来学问题，即如果AGI（人工通用智能）能够比人类更好地思考，政府是否会因为学校和大学不再具有经济价值而关闭它们。

补充讨论：
• smcleod的观点中带有对AI技术进步的乐观态度，认为AI可以扩展人类的能力，即使这种扩展源于现有思维能力的不足。
• joenot443和nottorp则对AI生成的内容持批评态度，认为其可能导致人们辨别能力的进一步下降，并提到历史上类似的问题（如“木语言”）。
• pgryko的评论引发了对教育系统未来可能受到AGI影响的深思，提出了技术进步对社会结构的潜在冲击。

争议焦点：
• AI是否会帮助提升人类的思维能力，还是反而会削弱人类的辨别和思考能力。
• AGI的崛起是否会导致传统教育体系的崩溃。

data.title: Claude Code for VSCode
data.author: tosh
data.article_summary: Claude Code for VSCode是一个VSCode插件，允许开发者在IDE中直接使用Claude Code的功能，提升编码效率。主要特性包括自动安装、选定文本自动添加到Claude上下文、代码更改显示在VSCode的差异查看器中、支持快捷键操作、以及标签页感知功能。该插件要求单独安装Claude Code，并需要VS Code 1.98.0或更高版本。当前为早期版本，可能存在错误或未完成的功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕不同代码代理工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot等）及其在IDE中的集成和使用的讨论。

不同观点：
• jbentley1认为代理编码不应集成到现有的IDE中，而是通过管理多个Git工作树和代理运行来实现，以避免等待时间。他还分享了自己开发的工具。
• bicx希望在同一个IDE窗口内实现基于`git worktree`的上下文切换，并提出了一系列功能需求，如终端代理、侧边栏监控等，以提高工作流效率。
• dewey对Cursor和Claude Code之间的区别感到困惑，认为除了命令行和图形界面的差异外，功能上区别不大，并提到在不同编辑器间切换的不便。
• Taylor_OD对GitHub Copilot的请求限制表示不满，并欢迎市场竞争带来的变化。
• b0a04gl讨论了代理工具对工作流的长期影响，认为它可以改变开发者的思维方式，从逐文件处理转向行动导向的处理方式。
• ewuhic和peter-m80则关注具体工具的兼容性和优势，例如Roo for VSCode和Copilot代理模式。
• fritzo更关注Cursor在处理长提示方面的优势，认为Cursor更重视提示的价值。
• 其他用户如coreyh14444和kissgyorgy则讨论了Claude Code插件的安装和市场发布的细节。

补充讨论：
• jdmoreira对Claude Code在JetBrains上的发布感到兴奋，提供了相关插件链接。
• yomismoaqui将Claude Code与Sourcegraph的Amp进行比较，认为未来几年这些工具的发展会很有趣。
• jasonthness强调了差分查看在其工作流中的重要性，并期待新工具能替代其现有设置。
• zackify和kissgyorgy提到Claude Code插件的发布只是将其已有的功能公开在市场中，并没有显著变化。

争议焦点：
• Cursor和Claude Code之间的实际区别以及各自的优势是用户讨论中的主要争议点。用户对两者功能相似但需要切换使用表示不满。
• 对GitHub Copilot限制请求数量的不满，以及用户对竞争工具的期待和欢迎态度。

data.title: Cyber Programming Language
data.author: scapbi
data.article_summary: Cyber是一种快速、高效、并发的脚本语言，官方页面为cyberscript.dev，提供性能指标和发布说明。该文档为语言参考手册，涵盖类型系统、语法、变量等内容。Cyber是静态类型语言，但也支持动态类型。语法简洁，语句以换行符结束，支持块结构和多种变量类型（本地、静态、上下文、extern和全局变量）。变量需遵循作用域规则，块结构通过缩进管理。静态变量在整个脚本生命周期内有效，但可能被其他变量类型取代。文档中还提及操作符、类型转换及注释等基础语法特性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Cyber语言的异步机制及其多线程支持

不同观点：
• [支持观点] two_handfuls 指出，Cyber语言的一个亮点是“colorless async”机制，这种机制为开发者提供了简化的异步编程方式。这种机制的引入能够降低异步编程的复杂性，提升开发效率。

• [改进空间] 同时，two_handfuls 也提到，目前Cyber的async机制尚未实现多线程支持。这表明尽管colorless async在简化异步编程方面有优势，但在性能优化和充分利用多核处理器方面还有待改进。

补充讨论：
• [背景信息] two_handfuls 提供了一个链接，对Cyber语言进行了概述和动机说明（https://cyberscript.dev/），这有助于理解为什么需要开发这种新语言以及其设计目标。

• [技术进展] 评论指出Cyber的async机制正在开发中，尚未实现多线程功能，这提示读者该语言的部分特性仍在完善，可能还不适合所有生产环境中的高并发需求。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于Cyber语言的async机制是否能在保持简化开发者体验的同时，实现高效的多线程支持，从而在性能和易用性之间找到平衡。这需要进一步的技术突破和优化。

44351998.article_content:
Introduction.
#
Cyber is a fast, efficient, and concurrent scripting language. The landing page is at
cyberscript.dev
and contains performance metrics and release notes.
These docs provide a reference manual for the language. You can read it in order or jump around using the navigation. You may come across features that are marked
Incomplete
or
Planned
. This is because the docs are written as if all features have been completed already.
Type System.
#

Cyber's syntax is concise and easy to read.
Statements.
#
A statement ends with the new line:
var a = 123
To wrap a statement to the next line, the last token before the new line must be an operator or a separator:
var gameover = health <= 0 or
player.collidesWith(spikes)
if year > 2020 and year <= 2030 and
month > 0 and month <= 11:

Any token inside a delimited syntax (such as parentheses or braces) can be wrapped to the next line:

Blocks.
#
Some statements can start a new block with a colon.
The first statement in a new block must be indented further.
Spaces or tabs can be used for indentation but not both.
-- This `if` statement begins a new block.
if true:
var a = 234
Subsequent statements in the block must follow the same indentation.
The block ends when a statement recedes from this indentation:
var items = {10, 20, 30}
for items -> it:
if it == 20:
print it
print it      -- This is the first statement outside of the `if` block.
Compact blocks allow only one statement after the starting block:
-- A single line block.
if true: print 123
if true: print 123
-- This is an indentation error since the compact block is already consumed.
print 234
Since blocks require at least one statement, use

pass

#

var b int = 123.0    --> CompileError. Expected `int`, got `float`.
Any operation afterwards that violates the type constraint of the variable will result in a compile error
a = 'hello'          --> CompileError. Expected `float`, got `String`.

The
.

44351998.article_summary: Cyber是一种快速、高效、并发的脚本语言，官方页面为cyberscript.dev，提供性能指标和发布说明。该文档为语言参考手册，涵盖类型系统、语法、变量等内容。Cyber是静态类型语言，但也支持动态类型。语法简洁，语句以换行符结束，支持块结构和多种变量类型（本地、静态、上下文、extern和全局变量）。变量需遵循作用域规则，块结构通过缩进管理。静态变量在整个脚本生命周期内有效，但可能被其他变量类型取代。文档中还提及操作符、类型转换及注释等基础语法特性。

data.title: First celestial image unveiled from revolutionary telescope
data.author: austinallegro
data.article_summary: 位于智利的Vera C. Rubin天文台发布了其首张天文图像，展示了距离地球9000光年的三裂星云和礁湖星云的细节。该天文台配备了世界上最强大的32亿像素相机，有望改变我们对宇宙的理解。它将探测杀手级小行星、绘制银河系地图，并寻找太阳系的潜在第九行星。该望远镜将在十年内持续观测南部夜空，帮助解答关于暗物质等关键宇宙问题。其高精度设计和独特的三镜系统使其能够捕捉到极其清晰的图像，每40秒拍摄一次，每晚拍摄8-12小时。这项观测将产生大量数据，由全球数百名科学家分析，重点关注瞬变天体、银河系形成、太阳系地图和暗物质研究。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Vera C. Rubin 天文台是否能在一年内发现太阳系的第九行星

不同观点：

• [flancian] 提供了关于Vera Rubin的个人介绍链接以及Vera C. Rubin天文台的介绍链接，暗示通过这些资源可以找到有关该天文台为何能更有效地寻找第九行星的信息，而没有直接回应质疑。

补充讨论：
• HansardExpert显然对文章中缺乏具体技术细节感到不满，他可能希望了解更多关于该天文台的设备能力或技术优势，尤其是与之前寻找第九行星的尝试相比有何不同。
• flancian提供的链接可能暗示，Vera C. Rubin天文台的独特之处在于其大规模巡天观测能力，尤其是其计划中的Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) 项目，该项目能够系统性地扫描整个南方天空，从而增加发现新天体的机会。
• 争议的焦点在于，为什么Vera C. Rubin天文台能在相对短的时间内（一年）找到第九行星，而其他搜索尝试多年未果。这可能涉及到天文台的技术参数、观测策略或数据处理能力等具体因素。

总结：讨论的核心在于Vera C. Rubin天文台是否具备在一年内发现第九行星的独特优势，以及对文章未提供足够技术细节的质疑。

First celestial image unveiled from revolutionary telescope
5 hours ago
Share

Ione Wells
South America correspondent
Georgina Rannard
Science correspondent
Share
Save
NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory
The first image revealed by the Vera Rubin telescope shows the Trifid and Lagoon nebulae in stunning detail
A powerful new telescope in Chile has released its first images, showing off its unprecedented ability to peer into the dark depths of the universe.
In one picture, vast colourful gas and dust clouds swirl in a star-forming region 9,000 light years from Earth.
The Vera C Rubin observatory, home to the world's most powerful digital camera, promises to transform our understanding of the universe.
If a ninth planet exists in our solar system, scientists say this telescope would find it in its first year.
RubinObs
Rubin Observatory and the Rubin Auxiliary Telescope in Cerro Pachón in Chile
It should detect killer asteroids in striking distance of Earth and map the Milky Way. It will also answer crucial questions about dark matter, the mysterious substance that makes up most of our universe.
This once-in-a-generation moment for astronomy is the start of a continuous 10-year filming of the southern night sky.
"I personally have been working towards this point for about 25 years. For decades we wanted to build this phenomenal facility and to do this type of survey," says Professor Catherine Heymans, Astronomer Royal for Scotland.
The UK is a key partner in the survey and will host data centres to process the extremely detailed snapshots as the telescope sweeps the skies capturing everything in its path.
Vera Rubin could increase the number of known objects in our solar system tenfold.
NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory
A huge cluster of galaxies including spiral galaxies in the vast Virgo cluster, which is about 100 billion times the size of the Milky Way.
BBC News visited the Vera Rubin observatory before the release of the images.
It sits on Cerro Pachón, a mountain in the Chilean Andes that hosts several observatories on private land dedicated to space research.
Very high, very dry, and very dark. It is a perfect location to watch the stars.
Maintaining this darkness is sacrosanct. The bus ride up and down the windy road at night must be done cautiously, because full-beam headlights must not be used.
The inside of the observatory is no different.
There is a whole engineering unit dedicated to making sure the dome surrounding the telescope, which opens to the night sky, is dark – turning off rogue LEDs or other stray lights that could interfere with the astronomical light they are capturing from the night sky.
The starlight is "enough" to navigate, commissioning scientist Elana Urbach explains.
One of the observatory's big goals, she adds, is to "understand the history of the Universe" which means being able to see faint galaxies or supernova explosions that happened "billions of years ago".
"So, we really need very sharp images," Elana says.
Each detail of the observatory's design exhibits similar precision.
SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory
Vera Rubin's is 3,200-megapixel camera was built by the US Department of Energy's SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory
It achieves this through its unique three-mirror design. Light enters the telescope from the night sky, hits the primary mirror (8.4m diameter), is reflected onto the secondary mirror (3.4m) back onto a third mirror (4.8m) before entering its camera.
The mirrors must be kept in impeccable condition. Even a speck of dust could alter the image quality.
The high reflectivity and speed of this allow the telescope to capture a lot of light which Guillem Megias, an active optics expert at the observatory, says is "really important" to observe things from "really far away which, in astronomy, means they come from earlier times".
The camera inside the telescope will repeatedly capture the night sky for ten years, every three days, for a Legacy Survey of Space and Time.
At 1.65m x 3m, it weighs 2,800kg and provides a wide field of view.
It will capture an image roughly every 40 seconds, for about 8-12 hours a night thanks to rapid repositioning of the moving dome and telescope mount.
It has 3,200 megapixels (67 times more than an iPhone 16 Pro camera), making it so high-resolution that it could capture a golf ball on the Moon and would require 400 Ultra HD TV screens to show a single image.
"When we got the first photo up here, it was a special moment," Mr Megias said.
"When I first started working with this project, I met someone who had been working on it since 1996. I was born in 1997. It makes you realise this is an endeavour of a generation of astronomers."
It will be down to hundreds of scientists around the world to analyse the stream of data alerts, which will peak at around 10 million a night.

data.article_summary: 本文探讨了大型推理模型在作为个人代理时存在的隐私泄露问题，特别是推理痕迹中可能包含敏感用户数据。尽管这些痕迹通常被认为是内部且安全的，但研究表明，通过提示注入或意外泄露，敏感信息可能被提取。增加推理步骤虽提升了模型回答的准确性，但也增加了隐私泄露的风险。文章强调，安全措施需涵盖模型的内部思考过程，而不仅限于其输出结果。

Title:
Leaky Thoughts: Large Reasoning Models Are Not Private Thinkers
Authors:
Tommaso Green
,
Martin Gubri
,
Haritz Puerto
,
Sangdoo Yun
,
Seong Joon Oh
View a PDF of the paper titled Leaky Thoughts: Large Reasoning Models Are Not Private Thinkers, by Tommaso Green and 4 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
We study privacy leakage in the reasoning traces of large reasoning models used as personal agents. Unlike final outputs, reasoning traces are often assumed to be internal and safe. We challenge this assumption by showing that reasoning traces frequently contain sensitive user data, which can be extracted via prompt injections or accidentally leak into outputs. Through probing and agentic evaluations, we demonstrate that test-time compute approaches, particularly increased reasoning steps, amplify such leakage. While increasing the budget of those test-time compute approaches makes models more cautious in their final answers, it also leads them to reason more verbosely and leak more in their own thinking. This reveals a core tension: reasoning improves utility but enlarges the privacy attack surface. We argue that safety efforts must extend to the model's internal thinking, not just its outputs.

data.author: pella
data.article_summary: 这篇文章详细介绍了NVIDIA Tensor Core从Volta到Blackwell的演变过程。文章首先讨论了性能工程的基本原则，包括Amdahl定律、强扩展与弱扩展，以及数据移动对性能的影响。接着，文章回顾了Tensor Core的架构演变，从Volta首次引入Tensor Core到Turing、Ampere、Hopper，以及最新的Blackwell架构。每一代Tensor Core都在异步执行、内存加速、数据类型精度和MMA指令等方面进行了改进。文章强调了Tensor Core对AI和深度学习性能提升的关键作用，并指出随着GPU架构和编程模型的快速演变，理解这些变化对研究人员和工程师越来越具挑战性。文章最后感谢了多位合作者的贡献，并表示希望为读者提供对NVIDIA GPU架构演变的深入理解。

In our
AI Scaling Laws article from late last year
, we discussed how multiple stacks of AI scaling laws have continued to drive the AI industry forward, enabling greater than Moore’s Law growth in model capabilities as well as a commensurately rapid reduction in unit token costs. These scaling laws are driven by training and inference optimizations and innovations, but advancements in compute capabilities transcending Moore’s Law have also played a critical role.
One this front, in the AI Scaling Laws article, we revisited the decades-long debate around compute scaling, recounting the end of Dennard Scaling in the late 2000s as well as the end of classic Moore’s Law pace cost per transistor declines by the late 2010s. Despite this, compute capabilities have continued to improve at a rapid pace, with the baton being passed to other technologies such as
advanced packaging
,
3D stacking
,
new transistor types
and specialized architectures such as the GPU.
Source: Nvidia
When it comes to AI and deep learning, GPU compute capabilities have improved at a faster than Moore’s law pace, consistently delivering remarkable “
Huang’s Law
” performance improvements year after year. The technology that is at the heart of driving this improvement is the Tensor Core.
Though the Tensor Core is unquestionably the bedrock upon which the foundations of modern AI and machine learning are built, it is not well understood, even by many experienced practitioners in the field. The rapid evolution of GPU architecture and programming models that run on this architecture means that it is increasingly challenging for Machine Learning researchers and scientists to keep up with the latest changes to Tensor Cores and grasp the implications of these changes.
Source: SemiAnalysis,
HC2023-K2: Hardware for Deep Learning
In this report, we will introduce the core features of the major datacenter GPUs, first explaining important first principles of performance engineering. We will then trace the evolution of Nvidia’s Tensor Core architectures and programming models, highlighting the motivations behind this evolution. Our end goal is to provide a resource for understanding Nvidia’s GPU architecture and offer intuitive insights into their architectural evolution. Only after explaining each architecture can we explain the beauty of the Blackwell tensor core and the new memory hierarchy of it.
It is important that we explain that a solid grasp of computer architecture is a prerequisite for being able to follow many of the explanations and discussions in this article, and this article will provide a brief section about CUDA programming as a refresher rather than explaining foundational concepts of GPU architecture. Instead, we build on the forefront of Tensor Core knowledge, extending understanding of this cutting-edge technology by documenting what is currently tribal knowledge into accessible, structured insight through detailed explanation.
Just as a university will teach 101 courses as well as 4000 level courses, different articles at SemiAnalysis will cater to varying levels of understanding of the subject matter as well as to readers in different vocations and specializations.

, Stanford Hazy Research: Offered great insights into programming model change and writing advice
Tri Dao
, Princeton and Together AI: Reviewed drafts and gave detailed feedback
Neil Movva
, Together AI: Reviewed drafts and off
44353146.article_summary: 这篇文章详细介绍了NVIDIA Tensor Core从Volta到Blackwell的演变过程。文章首先讨论了性能工程的基本原则，包括Amdahl定律、强扩展与弱扩展，以及数据移动对性能的影响。接着，文章回顾了Tensor Core的架构演变，从Volta首次引入Tensor Core到Turing、Ampere、Hopper，以及最新的Blackwell架构。每一代Tensor Core都在异步执行、内存加速、数据类型精度和MMA指令等方面进行了改进。文章强调了Tensor Core对AI和深度学习性能提升的关键作用，并指出随着GPU架构和编程模型的快速演变，理解这些变化对研究人员和工程师越来越具挑战性。文章最后感谢了多位合作者的贡献，并表示希望为读者提供对NVIDIA GPU架构演变的深入理解。

data.title: A new stem cell therapy for treating Type 1 diabetes
data.author: mitchbob
data.article_summary: 哈佛干细胞研究所（HSCI）的长期研究可能为1型糖尿病（T1D）的治疗带来了突破性进展。基于Melton实验室的研究，Vertex制药公司开发了VX-880，一种实验性的干细胞衍生的完全分化的胰岛细胞替代疗法。在1/2期临床试验中，第一位患者在接受半剂量VX-880和免疫抑制治疗后，第90天显示胰岛细胞功能显著恢复。患者血糖控制改善，外源性胰岛素需求减少，表明胰岛素产生细胞的恢复。VX-880不仅是一项潜在的T1D治疗突破，也是胚胎干细胞实际应用的首次展示。该疗法为患者提供了控制葡萄糖代谢的功能性激素产生细胞，有可能免除糖尿病患者终身自我注射胰岛素的需要。这些初步结果非常显著，支持继续推进临床研究。

44350814.article_content:
October 20, 2021
Promising early results show that longstanding Harvard Stem Cell Institute (HSCI) research may have paved the way for a breakthrough treatment of Type 1 diabetes. Utilizing research from the Melton Lab, Vertex Pharmaceuticals has developed VX-880, an investigational stem cell-derived, fully differentiated pancreatic islet cell replacement therapy for people with type 1 diabetes (T1D). In conjunction with immunosuppressive therapy, VX-880 produced robust restoration of islet cell function on Day 90 in the first patient in its Phase 1/2 clinical trial.
The patient was treated with a single infusion of VX-880 at half the target dose in conjunction with immunosuppressive therapy. The patient, who was diagnosed with T1D 40 years ago and has been dependent on exogenous (injected) insulin, achieved successful engraftment and demonstrated rapid and robust improvements in multiple measures. These included increases in fasting and stimulated C-peptide, improvements in glycemic control, including HbA1c, and decreases in exogenous insulin requirement, signifying the restoration of insulin-producing islet cells.
VX-880 is not only a potential breakthrough in the treatment of T1D, it is also one of the very first demonstrations of the practical application of embryonic stem cells, using stem cells that have been differentiated into functional islets to treat a patient, explained Doug Melton, Ph.D., co-director of HSCI, is the Xander University Professor at Harvard and an Investigator of the Howard Hughes Medical Institute. Unlike prior treatments, this innovative therapy gives the patient functional hormone producing cells that control glucose metabolism. This potentially obviates the lifelong need for patients with diabetes to self-inject insulin as the replacement cells “provide the patient with the natural factory to make their own insulin,” explained Melton.
These results from the first patient treated with VX-880 are unprecedented. What makes these results truly remarkable is that they were achieved with only half the target dose,” said Bastiano Sanna, Ph.D., Executive Vice President and Chief of Cell and Genetic Therapies at Vertex. “While still early, these results support the continued progression of our VX-880 clinical studies, as well as future studies using our encapsulated islet cells, which hold the potential to be used without the need for immunosuppression.”
“As a surgeon who has worked in the field of islet cell transplantation for decades, this approach, which obviates the need for an organ donor, could be a game changer,” said James Markmann, M.D., Ph.D., Professor of Surgery and Chief of the Division of Transplant Surgery at Massachusetts General Hospital. “We are excited to progress this unique and potentially transformative medicine through clinical trials and to patients.”
“More than a decade ago our lab had a vision for developing an islet cell replacement therapy to provide a functional cure to people suffering from T1D,” said Melton, a founder and one of the first co-chairs of the Harvard Stem Cell and Regenerative Biology Department. “These promising results bring great hope that stem cell-derived, fully differentiated islet cells could deliver a life-changing therapy for people who suffer from the relentless life-long burden of T1D. I'm so grateful that Harvard and the Harvard Stem Cell Institute have supported this work.”

主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）作为编程范式、软件开发工具的演变及其应用场景

不同观点：
• **OJFord**：对1.0/2.0/3.0分类表示怀疑，但认为可以将LLM视为一种新的编程范式，与传统的命令式、声明式、过程式和函数式语言类似。未来可能会出现确定性 vs. 概率性编程（LLM）的对比，例如通过提示让模型充当计算器。
• **gchamonlive**：认为传统编码、神经网络和提示的结合在某些领域非常有用，例如自动驾驶模块中神经网络取代代码。但受限于硬件条件，所谓的软件2.0和3.0的应用将受到限制，这些新范式更多是工具箱中的额外工具，而不是替代品。
• **practal**：赞同生成/验证循环加速的想法，并提出通过形式验证使AI在背后工作，而表面上使用自然语言（如英语）进行编程，隐藏背后的复杂逻辑。这需要抽象逻辑的支持。
• **sothatsit**：认为与LLM“紧密反馈循环”的配对编程体验不佳，倾向于延长反馈循环，将问题交给AI后处理其他任务，之后再回来调整和修改结果。

补充讨论：
• **dang**：赞赏演讲中的实际见解和可操作性，特别是“自主性滑块”等概念，认为演讲让人受益匪浅。
• **hgl**：设想一个真正的GUI for LLM，能够根据主题生成定制化的交互界面，实现非线性交互。
• **nilirl**：质疑LLM与其他概念（如操作系统、编程）的类比在哪里会失效，比如非确定性或成本结构。
• **mikewarot**：引用“精灵”比喻，指出与LLM交互时，小愿望可能会得到满足，但通常不会完全如愿。
• **abdullin**：强调紧密反馈循环在软件开发中的重要性，尤其是在大型遗留系统中。AI可以处理比人类更紧密的反馈循环，如自动运行测试和生成多个PR供选择。
• **beacon294**：关注演讲中使用的“clerk”库，并提供了相关链接。
• **wjohn**：认为当前与LLM的文本交互方式仍有改进空间，特别是对非开发者用户。
• **blobbers**：认为软件3.0是由机器生成的代码，而不是提示生成的输出，因为提示的输出具有随机性。机器生成的大量代码将迅速超过人类输出。
• **magicloop**：认为演讲捕捉到了当前软件创建的变化趋势，正在通过LLM重新思考应用架构，将模型结构变得可理解，并结合传统代码和AI的优势。
• **mkw5053**：指出在将AI添加到应用时面临的后端需求（如安全代理API调用、密钥管理等）问题，正在构建一个开源的“Firebase for LLMs”以解决此问题。
• **bicepjai**：质疑将LLM与电力类比是否恰当，认为LLM比加密技术更有实用性，但仍需考虑其能源成本。

争议焦点：
• LLM作为编程范式的适用性和局限性，特别是在与传统编程范式的对比中。
• 紧密反馈循环与延长反馈循环在使用LLM进行编程时的优劣。
• LLM与其他技术（如操作系统、电力）类比的有效性及其局限性。

data.title: Homotopy Equivalences
data.author: ibobev
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了拓扑学中用于判断形状等价的概念和方法。传统的同胚（homeomorphism）要求形状之间存在可逆的连续映射，但这不允许形状的剧烈收缩，比如环面缩小成圆圈。为了允许这种收缩，我们引入同伦等价（homotopy equivalence），其要求映射的复合不必是恒等映射，只需同伦于恒等映射。通过同伦，可以动画展示形状间的变换。例如，一条线段和一个点不是同胚的，但它们没有洞，因此是同伦等价的。

文章还介绍了基本群（fundamental group）和基本广群（fundamental groupoid），用于通过路径同伦分类路径。基本群能识别形状中的洞，如圆圈的基本群是整数群，表示绕圈的次数。更高阶的同伦群则通过n维球面检测更高维的洞。两个同伦等价的形状具有相同的基本群和同伦群，表明它们有相同的洞。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕数学中的拓扑学概念，尤其是关于多维空间包裹、同伦理论以及相关猜想的讨论。

不同观点：
• [skulk] 认为二维球面（2-sphere）可以任意次数地包裹核心，但对其具体视觉化表示感到困惑。他还提出由于存在更多维度，应该有多种包裹方式，并质疑为何 π^2(b^3 \ {0}) 仅等于 Z^2。他进一步询问如何证明没有其他方式。

• [hackandthink] 引用了Grothendieck的猜想，认为无穷广群捕捉了拓扑空间的所有信息，直至弱同伦等价。他还提到同伦假设的神秘性，并分享了一个相关资料链接。

• [m_j_g] 提供了一个相关的可视化工具链接，用于合成同伦的可视化，为理解同伦理论提供了一种实际操作的手段。

• [coderatlarge] 提到Terry Tao在一次访谈中讨论了Poincaré猜想，并指出Tao刻意避免使用某些术语，暗示了对复杂数学概念在公众传播中的简化需求。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了高维拓扑的概念，如2-sphere包裹多维空间的核心，以及同伦理论中的深层次猜想和假设。
• 提供了实际的工具和参考资料，帮助理解和可视化这些复杂的数学概念。
• 争议的焦点可能在于如何视觉化和证明高维拓扑结构的特性，以及在学术交流中如何平衡精确术语和公众理解。
